title: Influence of layer thickness on dimensional and geometrical properties of aluminium parts produced by powder bed fusion (Silva et al., Int J Adv Manuf Technol 138, 4755-4766, 2025)
publisher: Springer Nature, The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

rights.attribution: E. C. Silva, A. C. Lopes, A. M. Sampaio, A. J. Pontes, Int J Adv Manuf Technol 138 (2025) 4755-4766, DOI 10.1007/s00170-025-15592-x

notes: Only the abstract was read, on 2026-11-12, through the Crossref metadata record, which also gives the CC BY 4.0 licence. The publisher site answered a scripted client with a client challenge; that channel is recorded as unavailable and was not bypassed, so the body, tables and figures were not read. Abstract: three builds of a standard test artefact in AlSi10Mg at 0.025, 0.050 and 0.075 mm layers; pins, holes and staircase flats measured by computed tomography; relative dimensional errors tend to be higher in smaller features whatever the layer thickness; whatever the feature type the minimum size achieved was 0.5 mm, with tolerances between IT5 and IT11. The abstract names no machine and states nothing on fillets or corner radii.
